items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They have the little junior... Junior guys out there. And the women too. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: I think I've seen people younger than that. They have some junior divisions. Well, yeah. That's a junior. Junior societies. Yeah. They got them. Junior. Junior. They got them.
Junior. Arboration. Arboration. They say that. Who cares?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: I'm telling you, they hear them at Rampart and Junior? That's a good raise, man.

ctx.x: I'm telling you, they hear them at Rampart and Junior? That's a good raise, man.
Speaking of Rampart and Junior, why don't we put something about how you got sick on the tape, huh? Hmm? Let's put something on the tape about how you got sick.

Well, I'll tell you about that. The same little show I was been to called the Browns Mannequins. That had been a few years back. Now more than, I'd been more than 12 years. I had ate a piece of some rice pudding in Pensacola, Florida. I was going from Pensacola to Nashville. It was a good gym, see? And just on halfway, that rice custard got under your boy and I couldn't get no breath and nothing. Oh, it was giving me a fit. So they took me to the hospital in Nashville. They rushed me to the hospital. And a little…
